plan.denominator: All completed attempts in the requested window and filters

sql.name: quality
sql.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT attempt_id) FROM scenario_b.payments) AS duplicate_occurrences, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments WHERE attempt_id IS NULL OR attempt_id = '') AS missing_attempt_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments WHERE attempted_at IS NULL OR attempted_at = '') AS missing_timestamps, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments WHERE attempted_at <> '' AND (NOT pg_input_is_valid(attempted_at, 'timestamp with time zone') OR NOT attempted_at ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]+)?[+]05:30$')) AS malformed_timestamps, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments WHERE status IS NULL OR failure_reason IS NULL OR NOT ((status = 'SUCCESS' AND failure_reason = '') OR (status = 'FAILED' AND failure_reason IN ('BANK_TIMEOUT','INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS','AUTHENTICATION_FAILED','LIMIT_EXCEEDED')))) AS invalid_status_reason, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments WHERE amount_paise IS NULL OR NOT amount_paise ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$' OR currency IS NULL OR currency <> 'INR') AS invalid_amount_currency, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments WHERE payment_method IS NULL OR payment_method NOT IN ('CARD','UPI')) AS invalid_method, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments p LEFT JOIN scenario_b.merchants m ON p.merchant_id = m.merchant_id WHERE m.merchant_id IS NULL) AS orphan_merchants, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scenario_b.payments p LEFT JOIN scenario_b.banks b ON p.payer_bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE b.bank_id IS NULL) AS orphan_banks, (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT bank_id) FROM scenario_b.banks) AS duplicate_banks, (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT merchant_id) FROM scenario_b.merchants) AS duplicate_merchants

sql.name: overall
sql.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS period, COUNT(*) AS attempts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS') AS successes FROM scenario_b.payments p JOIN scenario_b.banks b ON p.payer_bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE ((CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz) OR (CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(c_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(c_end)s::timestamptz)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

sql.name: segments
sql.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS period, p.payer_bank_id, b.bank_name, p.payment_method, COUNT(*) AS attempts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS') AS successes FROM scenario_b.payments p JOIN scenario_b.banks b ON p.payer_bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE ((CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz) OR (CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(c_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(c_end)s::timestamptz)) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4

sql.name: daily
sql.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS period, CAST(CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS attempts, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'SUCCESS') AS successes FROM scenario_b.payments p JOIN scenario_b.banks b ON p.payer_bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE ((CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz) OR (CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(c_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(c_end)s::timestamptz)) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

sql.name: failures
sql.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS period, p.payer_bank_id, b.bank_name, p.payment_method, p.failure_reason, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scenario_b.payments p JOIN scenario_b.banks b ON p.payer_bank_id = b.bank_id WHERE ((CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(b_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(b_end)s::timestamptz) OR (CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) >= %(c_start)s::timestamptz AND CAST(p.attempted_at AS TIMESTAMPTZ) < %(c_end)s::timestamptz)) AND p.status = 'FAILED' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
